items.title: Joe Lyde Interview, 1959-05-18
items.q: I dropped, I landed in Boston, third Count Basie there one night, my first night in America.

ctx.x: And when you came over, did you come directly to New Orleans?

Well, I dropped, I landed in Boston, third Count Basie there one night, my first night in America. Okay. And then I sailed down from Boston to New York on a freighter. And caught a little bit of music there. And caught a little bit of music there, not much. Okay. Played with Wild Bill. That was my, just about my second night in America. I played with Condon.
Oh, yeah? Yeah. At what place?
